proposals.economic_premise: When a USD-M perpetual has positive funding, the short side receives the periodic transfer. Pairing a cash-funded long spot position with an equal-base-quantity short perpetual can reduce first-order spot directional exposure while supplying balance sheet to leveraged perpetual demand. The remaining payoff is carry and basis movement after all costs, collateral constraints, and failure paths.
proposals.ex_ante_payoff_direction: The paired position may receive funding only during positive-rate intervals. It has an economically positive premise only when funding and admissible basis effects exceed spot and perpetual fees, spread, slippage, financing, collateral drag, hedge error, and tail reserves.
proposals.paired_execution_path: Buy cash-funded spot and sell the same base quantity of the USD-M perpetual; settle signed funding at the official event time; maintain collateral and hedge tolerance; then close both legs with rollback, kill-switch, liquidation, ADL, and reconciliation evidence.
proposals.falsification_condition: Stop before return testing if a frozen full dataset cannot reconstruct funding, spot, perpetual, mark, index, premium, contract, fee, and margin state at each decision time, or if the paired execution protocol cannot model both legs and every declared failure path deterministically.

proposals.decision_rationale: This is the only screened premise whose required direction matches Aurex's audited long-spot/short-perpetual synthetic foundation without spot borrowing. The source census and pilot support bounded data feasibility. Selection authorizes only a separately frozen full-data and development-protocol design.

proposals.economic_premise: A perpetual trading above its point-in-time spot or index reference may converge as funding encourages the opposing paired position and constrained arbitrage capital enters. A long-spot short-perpetual pair could therefore isolate some premium compression, but a perpetual has no expiry date that guarantees convergence.
proposals.ex_ante_payoff_direction: The proposed pair benefits only if the observed premium compresses enough to exceed both-leg execution costs, funding paid or received, collateral drag, hedge error, and adverse basis expansion.
proposals.paired_execution_path: Buy cash-funded spot and short the same-base USD-M perpetual while tracking mark, index, premium, funding, hedge tolerance, collateral, and paired close or rollback evidence.
proposals.falsification_condition: Do not elevate this related premise if the later primary protocol cannot distinguish ex-ante premium compression from funding carry, or if point-in-time premium and executable paired-leg costs cannot be reconstructed without outcome-conditioned thresholds.

proposals.decision_rationale: The premise is research-supported and mechanically expressible, but it overlaps the selected carry pair and has no expiry-forced terminal convergence. It may only become a nonselectable diagnostic defined inside a later frozen protocol, never a second best-result candidate.

proposals.economic_premise: When funding is negative, the perpetual long receives the periodic transfer. Hedging that exposure would require shorting the underlying spot asset against the long perpetual, making borrow availability, interest, limits, recall, liquidation, and close-out behavior part of the mechanism rather than optional implementation details.
proposals.ex_ante_payoff_direction: The reverse pair may receive negative funding only if the spot short can be borrowed and maintained. Any funding receipt must exceed borrow interest, both-leg costs, basis movement, recall risk, collateral drag, and liquidation reserves.
proposals.paired_execution_path: Borrow and short spot, buy the same base quantity of the USD-M perpetual, settle negative funding to the long, accrue borrow costs, and reconcile borrow, spot, perpetual, collateral, repayment, recall, liquidation, and close-out state.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject under this charter unless point-in-time historical borrow availability, rates, limits, recalls, and repayment state can be reconstructed and a separately audited reverse-carry execution model covers both legs, borrow accounting, and forced close-out.

limitations: Development, validation, holdout, forward paper, sandbox, live, and capital permissions remain closed.
